fd.footer: entries sealed on your device · photos encrypted · for the space, friends, a circle or only you
fd.textPlaceholder: What’s new? Markdown works; #hashtags make it easy to find.
fd.textHint: Markdown for formatting, #hashtags for topics. Up to six photos.
fd.aud.circleGone: A circle that no longer exists
fd.aud.space.hint: Everyone using a hub that serves {space} can read it. Relays and search engines see only ciphertext, but it is no secret from someone who looks for it.
fd.aud.friends.hint: Your friends can read it, also friends you add later. Someone you remove reads nothing you post after that.
fd.aud.circle.hint: Only the people in this circle can read it, also people you add to it later. Someone you take out reads nothing you post after that.
fd.error.empty: Write something or add a photo.
fd.emptySpace: Nothing in this space yet. Be the first to post.
fd.noFriends: No friends yet: add some in the settings, or from anyone’s entry.
fd.emptyMine: You haven’t posted anything here yet.
fd.emptyPerson: Nothing from this person that you can read.
fd.deleteText: It disappears for everyone who could read it, with its comments.
fd.blocked: Blocked. Their entries, comments and likes are hidden on all your devices.
fd.reportText: Reports go to the relays, signed by you, so the space’s moderators, relay operators and other clients can act. An entry that a moderator or several people reported is folded away here.
fd.foldedModerator: Folded away: a moderator of this space reported it.
fd.foldedReports: Folded away: several people reported it.
fd.notForYou: This entry is gone, or it is not for you: its writer did not share it with you, or the key has not reached this device yet.
fd.foreignSpace: This link leads into the space “{space}”, which this hub does not serve.
fd.openElsewhere: Open it where it came from
fd.how.1: An entry is a signed nostr event, sealed before it leaves your browser: for the space, your friends, a circle or yourself. Its photos are encrypted with keys that travel inside it. Whoever cannot read an entry does not see it at all.
fd.settings.audienceText: Who a new entry is for, unless you choose otherwise when you write it. Saved in your account.
fd.settings.circles: Circles are made in the site settings
